  | description              = A comforting and inspiring presence surrounds you as you hold this carving. A short chain of adamantine connects the carved head to a curiously shaped polyhedron with 20's carved on each side.
  | tips                     = 
* Many players don't slot this trinket until just before receiving XP at the end of a quest. When a party is about to fight the final boss or open the last chest, you will often hear a player say "Voices!" as a reminder to the group. Alternatively, someone might type "VOM" or "V" in party chat to remind you to slot the trinket.
* This item was added in [[Module 7]] to remember Gary Gygax, who created Dungeons and Dragons and narrated Delera's Tomb.
* This is part of the {{DM's Vision}} item set, along with the [[Mantle of the Worldshaper]] from [[The Abandoned Excavation]].
